patthana15.2:1.1: hetuṃ sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu
patthana15.2:2.1: na sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na
patthana15.2:3.1: hetuṃ sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana15.2:4.1: hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe tīṇi. avigate tīṇi,
patthana15.2:6.1: hetuṃ dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana15.2:8.1: hetuṃ adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutta dhammaṃ paṭicca na adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
